about: Tag layer (applied in js/common.js load()): fills MISSING values only, never overrides curated or OSM data. cuisineTags: added to a restaurant's cuisine tags when it has no tag that maps to a 'By cuisine' / quiz group (TG.CUISINES); sources in order: current OpenStreetMap cuisine tag, the place's name, curated cuisine text, its own website (title / meta description). Left out when unsure. features: OpenStreetMap tags added since the import (outdoor_seating, wheelchair, takeaway). Checked 30 Oct 2026.
